description: 8 retrieval probes for karlseguin/http.zig — an MIT-licensed Zig HTTP server library (31 .zig files). Exercises canonical Zig patterns: `pub const X = struct`, `pub fn name(...) !T` error-union return types, `comptime` generic-type-returning functions (Zig's metaprogramming idiom), errdefer cleanup, function-typed parameters. Zig has NO tree-sitter grammar in GRAMMAR_MAP — chunking uses the regex chunker in registry-tooling.js:76-104 with rules for `fn X`, `const X = struct`, `const X = enum`.

probes.query: how does http.zig parse an incoming HTTP request from a socket buffer with headers body cookies
probes.notes: NL behavior probe: `pub const Request = struct` (line 22) holds the parsed HTTP request state — body bytes, headers map, params, query parser, cookie accessor. Entry point for handler functions.

probes.query: how does http.zig dispatch middleware actions through the request response pipeline
probes.notes: NL behavior probe: `pub fn Dispatcher(comptime Handler: type, comptime ActionArg: type) type` (line 162) and adjacent `Action`/`DispatchableAction`/`Middleware` (lines 155-179) build the request handler signature at compile time. These are comptime type-returning functions — Zig's metaprogramming idiom.

probes.query: buffer pool to reuse byte allocations across requests in http.zig
probes.notes: NL behavior probe: `pub const Pool = struct` (line 25) is the reusable Buffer pool — `init` allocates count×buffer_size, `acquire`/`release` rent/return slots. Avoids per-request allocator overhead.

probes.query: Request struct with body header param query cookies methods Zig
probes.notes: Symbol-anchored probe: `pub const Request = struct` (line 22) — see ZG-001 for context. The struct's methods: `body`, `header`, `param`, `query`, `cookies`, `json` (lines 126-160).

probes.query: Response struct with json header setStatus setCookie methods Zig
probes.notes: Symbol-anchored probe: `pub const Response = struct` (line 20) — buffered response builder; `setStatus` (line 96), `header`/`headerOpts` (lines 91/110), `setCookie` (line 100), `json` (line 85).

probes.query: Buffer struct with len data fields and slice access
probes.notes: Symbol-anchored probe: `pub const Buffer = struct` (line 9) — the reusable byte buffer slot held by Pool.

probes.query: comptime function returning a generic Dispatcher type for action handler signatures
probes.notes: Grammar-edge-case probe: `pub fn Dispatcher(comptime Handler: type, comptime ActionArg: type) type` (line 162) — Zig's idiom of using `fn ... type` as a compile-time type factory. The regex chunker's `function /^(?:pub\s+)?fn\s+(\w+)/` captures `Dispatcher` cleanly; the `comptime` parameter qualifiers + `type` return aren't part of the name regex but don't block the anchor.

probes.query: Pool init returns error union with errdefer cleanup on allocation failure
probes.notes: Grammar-edge-case probe: `pub fn init(io: Io, allocator: Allocator, count: usize, buffer_size: usize) !Pool` (line 35) inside `pub const Pool = struct` (line 25). Demonstrates Zig's `!T` error-union return type and `errdefer { allocator.free(buffers); }` cleanup pattern (lines 37, 40). The chunker captures `Pool` as the enclosing struct; init/errdefer are inner content not separate entities.
